name: Lab 87 -- Webhook Signature Bypass: a payment webhook handler defines an HMAC signature check but never calls it, so any forged event is trusted.
notes: Local lab on port 5087. Copy this preset to project.json in a fresh directory, then launch NullockApp --project=<absolute-directory>. Start the lab separately with python app.py. Advanced scope restricts traffic to localhost or 127.0.0.1 on this port.
